actions.text: We take the cbrt here so that points don't get clustered in the center.
Return a string containing the Cartesian coordinates separated by spaces.

actions.text: Player starts invulnerable for a brief period.

children.text: Ignore collisions if the game is over.
Destroy the player if they collide with a projectile.

parameters.value: distance3d(Player.X, Player.Y, Player.Z, Projectile.X, Projectile.Y, Projectile.Z) < Projectile.Width * 2.25

children.text: Destroy both the player and the enemy if they collide.

parameters.value: distance3d(Player.X, Player.Y, Player.Z, Enemy.X, Enemy.Y, Enemy.Z) < Enemy.Width * 1.8

children.text: Destroy the enemy if it collides with a projectile.

parameters.value: distance3d(Enemy.X, Enemy.Y, Enemy.Z, Projectile.X, Projectile.Y, Projectile.Z) < Projectile.Width * 2.5

children.text: Replenish ammo if the player collides with an ammo canister.

parameters.value: distance3d(Player.X, Player.Y, Player.Z, Ammo.X, Ammo.Y, Ammo.Z) < Ammo.Height

children.text: Replenish fuel if the player collides with a fuel tank.

parameters.value: distance3d(Player.X, Player.Y, Player.Z, Fuel.X, Fuel.Y, Fuel.Z) < Fuel.Height

children.text: Move projectiles if they are inside the battle zone, otherwise destroy them.

parameters.value: distance3d(Projectile.X, Projectile.Y, Projectile.Z, zoneCenterX, zoneCenterY, 0) < ZONE_RADIUS

children.text: Force the player to stay within the battle zone limits.

parameters.value: distance3d(Player.X, Player.Y, Player.Z, zoneCenterX, zoneCenterY, 0) > MOVE_RADIUS

actions.text: Slowdown the player so that they don't escape the battle zone.

parameters.x:
HUD_Minimap.X
   + (
       (Enemy.X - Player.X) * cos(-90 - Player.Angle)
       - (Enemy.Y - Player.Y) * sin(-90 - Player.Angle)
     ) / ZONE_RADIUS * HUD_Minimap.Width/2.4
parameters.y:
HUD_Minimap.Y
   + (
       (Enemy.X - Player.X) * sin(-90 - Player.Angle)
       + (Enemy.Y - Player.Y) * cos(-90 - Player.Angle)
     ) / ZONE_RADIUS * HUD_Minimap.Height/2.4

parameters.opacity: distance(Player.X, Player.Y, Enemy.X, Enemy.Y) < ZONE_RADIUS ? max(10, 100 - (abs(Player.Z - Enemy.Z)/ZONE_RADIUS * 100)) : 0
